tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are a student who recently participated in a group project for your marketing class. One of your group members, Lisa, did an excellent job on her part of the project. Write an email to Lisa.
bullets: Thank her for her excellent contribution to the group project.
Explain what part of Lisa's contribution you appreciated most and how her efforts helped the team succeed.
Suggest working together on future projects and ask for her opinion.
tasks.subject: Appreciation for group project contribution
